_comment: IHE-PCD ACM Clinical Device Database — Consumer-side calibration data.

filter_params._comment: Two-axis adaptive filter tuning. horizon_T [s] couples the FIR window s_j(t) and the hysteresis rate rho=(1-SDC)/T; alpha biases SDC_score toward the peak threat max(v_j).

priority_map._comment: BICEPS AlertCondition.Priority -> static SDC priority P_j.

odds_ratios._comment: FHIR diagnosis/danger code -> OR_d for Context_Log_Odds = ln(O_0) + sum(R_d * ln(OR_d)). Unknown codes default to OR=1.0 (neutral).

device_profiles._comment: Bayesian reliability priors: Manufacturer -> ModelName -> ConceptCode -> {sensitivity, false_alarm_rate}. Stage 2 (ClinicalRiskFilter). prior=0.005.

Infinity Monitor._comment: Bedside patient monitor — HR channel. LR+ = 0.99/0.15 = 6.60. Phase 3 risk = P*×10.0.

Space Perfusor._comment: Syringe infusion pump — line pressure. LR+ = 0.95/0.08 = 11.875.
